# GODFATHER Fas 2A: data quality and observation integrity

Nothing in the LIVE entry strategy, the GODFATHER decision policy,
Guardian Authority, promotion, leverage, sizing, limits, SL/TP or the
safety kernel was changed. 0 AI calls. The only change on the trading
side is a 10-line single-instance lock in `run.py`.

## What was found (root causes)

1. **"Guardian starts 27 min after entry" was a timestamp artefact.**
   `opened_at` and the paper entry price are stamped at the START of the
   deciding discovery run. The position only exists once the AI analysis
   finishes, 10–27 minutes later. Measured from the LIVE claim,
   Guardian's first observation follows after a median **0.3 min**.
2. **Monitoring outages leave exits unverified.**
   - The bot was frequently off overnight: 22 monitoring gaps, up to
     90 h.
   - Before 2026-09-11 there was no candle catch-up at all.
   - Since then catch-up replays at most 1000 minutes. Anything older
     in a longer outage is never replayed.
   - 39 closed trades overlap such unrecovered windows.
3. **Two bot processes ran at the same time on 2026-09-12.** There were
   629 overlapping Guardian runs and 635 near-duplicate observations,
   and every loop, LIVE execution included, ran twice. There was no
   protection against a second instance.
4. **USDT results were not comparable.** Position sizes range from 84 to
   2 545 USDT.

| TIGHTEN_SL −6.24 USDT (n = 27) | −0.15 R (n = 21), dedicated evaluation −0.12 R. Still SUSPECT and weaker, but 3 of 4 walk-forward blocks are negative. |

## Data quality verdict

**Correct now**

- An exit is evidence only when it was actually observed: by candles in
  continuous monitoring, by replayed candles, or by the exchange fill.
  Otherwise the trade is UNOBSERVABLE and excluded.
- MFE/MAE/time-to-event come only from paths observed without a hole
  > 10 min from **activation**. The analysis window before activation is
  flagged `DECISION_TO_ACTIVATION_DELAY`, not treated as a gap.
- R = real result ÷ the **planned** risk (planned entry → original SL).
  A LIVE fill more than 1 % from plan is flagged. A later tightened SL is
  never used. R is UNAVAILABLE rather than a guess.
- Experience Memory, the policy registry, entry selection, the portfolio
  layer and the TIGHTEN_SL evaluation compare in R. USDT is kept as a
  separate capital measure.
- Gapped-through stops are flagged `STOP_OVERSHOOT`. They are kept, not
  hidden: they are real risk.
- One bot process per database, enforced by an OS lock that is released
  automatically on a crash.

**Still limited (not changed: trading path, needs a separate decision)**

- **Catch-up covers at most 1000 min.** Outages longer than about
  16.7 h will still produce unverifiable paper exits. It could be fixed
  by paging klines over the whole gap in `monitoring_catchup.py`, which
  is a change to the paper engine.
- **The paper entry is priced at decision time**, 10–27 min before the
  position exists. Paper outcomes therefore include price drift during
  the analysis; 6 LIVE fills differ from plan by > 1 %.
- 542 monitoring runs ended `partial_error`, where an instrument may have
  been skipped. This is not tracked per instrument.
- The history itself: 25 exits are gone for good, and only 29 trades
  have a fully observed path.

**What needs new LIVE data**

With the lock and continuous uptime, every new trade should become
COMPLETE. Fully observed paths (29 today) are the bottleneck for all
MFE/MAE, entry-success and management statistics. The policy gates need
at least 30 observed interventions each; TIGHTEN_SL is at 21 in R.

## Tests

- GODFATHER: 338 passed, 28 of them new for Fas 2A. They cover gaps
  before SL, before TP and through both SL/TP; exchange history
  available and unavailable; the UNOBSERVABLE fallback; activation vs
  decision time; late first observation; stop overshoot; R long, short,
  across sizes, a later moved SL, a missing or invalid SL, an exchange
  outcome against planned risk; the experience filter; classification
  in R; the instance lock including a crashed holder; and Guardian
  observing a new position on the next tick.
- Full suite: 2097 passed, 8 failed. Those are only the 8 known config-default failures
  (profit_protection/authority defaults), identical to before.
